description: For electrical service, this completion sign-off form records reported condition, troubleshooting boundary, isolation plan, parts, outage window, permits, and testing. Its supporting evidence includes meter readings, one-line reference, fault observations, thermal image, device condition, and test results.

title: Electrical Service Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during electrical service diagnosis and controlled repair when the electrical service record must identify panel, circuit, voltage, load, disconnect, equipment served, labels, and occupancy impact. Complete the applicable handoff for functional test, label update, energized release, customer explanation, permit result, and service record.
